messages:
Maya: Heads up — the launch-week dashboard shows a 22% drop in MQL->SQL conversion on Tue. Anyone see routing or tagging changes? :eyes:
Elena: I grabbed the raw lead stream. The drop aligns with a big jump in 'webinar_promo' traffic but lower qualify rate (~8% vs usual 18%).
Tom: Could be UTM rewrites on the registration page. I deployed a tiny HTML rewrite last Thu to fix a tracking param.
Rajat: Confirmed — I changed an inbound routing rule Friday to collapse source=webinar_v2 into channel=paid-social (rule id 78123). Did that to reduce duplicate queues.
Maya: Ugh. That would mangle attribution. Can you paste the rule and a quick sample? We need to reconcile before the KPI review.
Rajat: Rule 78123: rewrite(source=webinar_v2 -> channel=paid-social) ; affected 4.2k leads Sat-Sun. Sample rows:
```
lead_id: 89321, utm_source:webinar_v2, canal:paid-social, created_at:2026-03-21T14:03Z
lead_id: 89322, utm_source:webinar_v2, canal:paid-social, created_at:2026-03-21T14:05Z
```
Elena: Also noticed our attribution window for the webinar flow was shortened from 30d -> 7d in the GA->SFDC mapping last month. That change removes longer nurture touches from counting as MQLs.
Tom: Shorter window + collapsing source into paid_social = double hit. No wonder the conversion math is off.
Maya: Options: rollback the routing rule and revert the attribution window for 'webinar_v2' (quick), or annotate the KPI deck and treat this as a reporting change (medium). What's the effort?
Rajat: Rollback is low-risk, I can revert rule 78123 now (1-2m). Attribution window revert needs a config change in the ETL mapping and a re-run of the crosswalk job (~30m + backfill for last 30d).
Elena: For the weekly KPI slide, I'll add a footnote and a provisional line showing adjusted MQL counts if we revert both changes. Quick SQL I ran: SELECT source, count(*) FROM leads WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-20' GROUP BY 1; gives +1.9k MQLs if we map webinar_v2 separately.
Tom: If rollback helps, let's do it and then decide on the attribution backfill. Ops can do the heavy lift tonight if needed.
Maya: Do it, please. Rajat, please also post a short note in the deck about the timing so Sales doesn't chase phantom dips.
Rajat: Starting rollback now. ops-bot: rollback initiated for rule 78123 by Rajat. :rocket:
ops-bot: rollback completed for rule 78123 — traffic now maps webinar_v2 -> channel=webinar (2026-03-23 15:20 UTC).
Elena: Re-running the dashboard query now, will push an updated slide to the KPI deck and add the footnote: "Conversion dip on Mar 21 due to temporary attribution + routing config changes; counts updated after rollback."
Maya: Thank you team. We'll call out the change in tomorrow's KPI sync. I'll own the slide notes. :thumbsup:
Tom: Nice catch Rajat + Elena. Good to have the quick rollback option.
Maya: Closing loop — follow-up action: (1) Rajat to file a PR to add a staging test for inbound routing rules, (2) Elena to run a 30d backfill if leadership asks, (3) Tom to check landing page params to avoid silent rewrites.
Rajat: Filed ticket #MK-4092 with rollback details and staging test plan.
Maya: Perfect — thanks everyone.
